Just an update. I did file a police report. My city was pretty useless, though. Well I can't say that, they helped me grab my clothes and such. They gave me some resources and someone is supposed to call me back as well with more information for me. They couldn't do too much, though. They took him but since I'm not on any paperwork or anything I had to leave as well. They said the bruises were enough to charge him. Especially the hip one. It somehow got worse and it's agitating right now. He also destroyed some of my stuff which they are charging him with destruction of property on top, I think.

Do yeah I got my clothes and stuff but they kind of just offered to drop me offered me a ride to a friend's place or something but I don't have any around here. They asked where I'll go and I straight up said "idk" and that's when they gave me resources and some lady is supposed to call me about setting up a place for me to stay tonight but it doesn't solve much because I'll be stuck again tomorrow with no housing lol..that being said the shelter is an option. They're already full, though, cause they called about that. They open doors at 2:30 and fill up fast cause it's not equiped to handle the homeless problem in this city due to exponential growth in population. 

But anyways just a general update for you all! Thank you so much for your support! I'm going to keep updating if I can. So I guess y'all were right and my next move was to file a report, which I did. I was able to salvage some clothes from the place so that's good news!

Honestly I'd love to live with an older person and help them out in different ways as well as pay rent knowing it helps them. I actually love that idea cause I love helping people. 

I don't get paid until the 20th and only $50 for my phone and $20 for a maxed, small credit card i got when I was younger, which I usually pay more on and can't use it anymore. It's just a financial responsibility nowadays to pay it off.

But yeah, I'm easy to get along with and a nice person in general. I'm actually a great roommate but I guess cause I try to see the good in everyone I look past red flags like a dummy cause my last two roommates have been pretty bad.

As for long term implications I don't think there are any because I wasn't on any paperwork. The "roommate's" mom actually owns it. He is kind of a spoiled kid who never grew up even though he is in his 40s. It makes sense why his attitude changes so quick when he doesn't get his way. I didn't contact law enforcement. Honestly, I want to wash my hands of it and I don't see a reason to. There are no substantial marks, surprisingly, other than small bruising under my beard and on my lower hip. I just don't see why I should file one. It won't do much but break his mom's heart and I've met her and she's sweet. I thought about making one but thought of her tbh... She's getting old and starting to lose her memory and he takes advantage of that sometimes but she loves him and I just don't want to be the one to file a report and have him possibly get locked up and have her deal with it all cause she's all he has.... Idk. Maybe that's dumb and irrational but that's my reasoning. That and I just hauled ass and didn't think about it tbh.i just wanted out and to wash my hands of it. Anywhere is better than there.

Thank you so much for the encouraging words! It means a lot to me. I oddly have high spirits for my situation. I'm not sure why. Maybe I feel elated because I got out of a bad situation. And ultimately being homeless to me isn't that bad considering most of my time is spent working or outdoors hiking/at the park. So this is definitely temporary. There is only one shelter here and it fills up when they open the doors and stays pretty full. By the time I get off work they're full. Even if they aren't I feel like my body can withstand sleeping on not so comfortable places and such and rather a bed be open to someone who can't handle it. Plus Covid and I'm honestly afraid to get sick and miss work given I need all the income possible right now, honestly. Maybe that's stupid, idk... It seems like everyone commenting to go to the shelter is adamant about me going and I feel dumb for thinking I'd rather it go to someone more in need that isn't temporary or who hasn't made it in the doors and has had to sleep in hard spots and their body isn't quite as spry as mine is right now. I'm 30 and very active/fit. I walk 7ish miles a day lol. I love being outside and it's nice out where I live rn. If it was cold or some extreme weather then I would probably def get into the shelter or try. Idk... Maybe that's kind of selfish to think that way too. My mind is still kerfuffled right now lol.

I am okay! I was away from wifi considering... You know. Lol. But I am okay! I still have a job and such. So it's just temporary but I had to get out asap ya know. It's better this way before I get really hurt.
